body: A delay, rejection, or hard limit will quickly force you to confront exactly what your current plan can actually support. When the Sun opposes Saturn, your confidence meets external resistance, usually arriving through a deadline, a new rule, or a gatekeeper with enough authority to tell you no. A setback might demand a smaller scope or a longer timeline, but it does not automatically mean the larger goal is flawed. Treat a "no" as a structural data point rather than a final verdict on your potential. Identify the exact terms of the roadblock and pivot your strategy to operate within the space that is actually open.
